title: Minimal Maybes
subtitle: Clean geometry and negative space in a minimal generative study.
seo_title: Minimal Maybes: Generative Restraint with Clean Geometry and Space
seo_description: A minimal abstract series balancing clean geometry, negative space, and simple color relationships, built with a generative pipeline and precise finishing.

tiles: Clean geometry with ample negative space
Simple color steps and crisp edges
challenge: Pursuing maximum visual impact through maximum restraint. The creative brief was to produce Bauhaus-influenced compositions where every shape earns its place, negative space does as much work as positive form, and a limited color palette creates quiet harmony across the series.
approach: Used Adobe Firefly to generate base geometric forms with careful spacing, then refined edge integrity, color pacing, and micro-contrast relationships in Lightroom. The finishing process focused on eliminating excess rather than adding complexity.
result: Produced a six-piece minimal abstraction series with quiet, confident compositions that present cleanly in portfolio grids and carry enough structural integrity for high-quality art prints and gallery-scale display.
